metadata.title: Natural color composites of VENµs images over South Col Glacier
metadata.description: This datasets contain images of South Col Glacier obtained from VENµs platform from 27 Nov 2017 to 30 Oct 2020. The images are shown on a UTM45\WGS84 projection, and correspond to the band combination 7-4-3. The two stars show remarkable locations.

title: Natural color composites of VENµs images over South Col Glacier
